title: Sepsis-3 cohorts across sources
text: Third International Consensus defines sepsis suspected infection co-occurring acute increase organ dysfunction, measured SOFA score. packaged implementation follows widely used operational form: Suspected infection. Pair antibiotic body-fluid culture. culture came first, antibiotic must follow within 72 hours; antibiotic came first, culture must follow within 24 hours. earlier event first qualifying pair suspicion time. SOFA. Compute six-organ SOFA score stay keep windows SOFA ≥ 2 absolute terms. Combination. Keep ICU stays qualifying SOFA window falls within −48 +24 hours suspicion time. 72-hour 24-hour windows point opposite directions purpose: culture drawn first can followed antibiotics 72 hours, antibiotic given first must paired culture within 24 hours. eICU culture table equivalent MIMIC’s, implementation uses antibiotic-suspicion (ricu convention) SOFA port. MIMIC-III implementation includes SOFA port well, absolute SOFA ≥ 2 rule applies every source, one written .

title: Build a Sepsis-3 cohort ID list for a source, optionally importing it — build_sepsis_cohort
text: src_name Source name (e.g. "mimic_iii_demo"). base_dir Project root source's raw demo data. raw_data_root Optional parent storage-root override raw source data. source directory derived {raw_data_root}/{src_name}. Forwarded cohort-selection step (.ehr_select_cohort_ids_duckdb()) import step (import_cohort_general()), agree raw CSVs live. out_csv Optional path write full cohort_sql result (every ID column selected, just key) CSV. NULL import = TRUE, temporary file used internally removed afterward. import TRUE (default), import selected cohort via import_cohort_general(direct_ids_path = ...). overwrite Passed import_cohort_general() import = TRUE. Default FALSE. bundle cohort definition run packaged Sepsis-3 SQL chain (setup_sql chain unchanged either way). Default "sepsis3": every ICU stay met Sepsis-3 criteria, qualifying suspicion--infection event anywhere stay - answers "patient ever septic ICU course", runs much higher admission-time sepsis-prevalence studies (e.g. mimic_iii_demo, 95 ICU stays 70 patients captured). "first_sepsis3": restricted patient's absolute first-ever ICU stay (septic ) - sepsis3-mimic (Johnson et al. 2018) study-cohort restriction (mimic_iii_demo: 95 -> 66 stays). eICU, cross-hospitalization ordering "first_sepsis3" approximate (eICU exact cross-admission timestamp, year-granularity discharge year), ties within discharge year broken patienthealthsystemstayid: reproducible, though necessarily chronological. "sepsis3_admission": instead restricted stays whose qualifying suspicion--infection event falls within +/-1 day ICU/unit admission - sepsis3-mimic suspicion-timing exclusion; smaller effect (mimic_iii_demo: 95 -> 88). "first_sepsis3_admission": restrictions together (mimic_iii_demo: 61) - closest packaged match sepsis3-mimic study population, still well study's suspected-infection count (sepsis_suspicion: 28, pre-SOFA) reproduce study's separate adult/MetaVision/CSURG exclusions - specific one MIMIC-III-era study, part Sepsis-3 clinical definition shared MIMIC-IV/eICU, live sepsis_suspicion/sepsis_suspicion_modified instead. import_scope Passed import_cohort_general() import = TRUE. Default "hospital": every Sepsis-3-positive ICU stay, also pulls ICU stay within hospitalization, patient's , separate hospitalizations. Sepsis-3 common enough general ICU population (58% mimic_iii patients qualify least ) engine's default NULL (full patient history, every hospitalization patient ever ) ends including ~83% entire chartevents table - almost whole dataset, focused cohort. title: Clean concept values using statistical outlier rules — clean_by_outlier
text: Methods: iqr Tukey fences: [Q1 - k*IQR, Q3 + k*IQR], default k = 1.5. Robust, distribution-light - usual first choice. mad median +/- k * (1.4826 * MAD), default k = 3. robust heavy tails; good skewed clinical labs. sd mean +/- k * sd, default k = 3. Assumes roughly symmetric data; sensitive outliers tries find.

"*N" "/N" - multiply divide every value N. items without unit column; unit column error, unrecognised units converted . Use "map" instead. "f_to_c" - Fahrenheit Celsius conversion. unit column, recognised Fahrenheit labels (F, Deg. F, ...) converted; values already target_unit unit kept, unit becomes NULL. "cond_f_to_c" - items without unit: values 70 taken Fahrenheit converted. "fio2_fraction" - FiO2 items mix fractions percents: values (0, 1] multiplied 100, values (1, 20) become NULL, others kept percents. "ca_ionized_by_value" - ionized calcium reported mmol/L mg/dL one unit label (eICU): values 2 taken mmol/L, values 3.5 mg/dL multiplied 0.2495, values become NULL. unit column ignored. "dipstick_grade" - qualitative urine dipstick results: NEG 0, SM/1+ 1, MOD/2+ 2 LG/3+ 3 (full words accepted ). unit column ignored text becomes NULL. "map" - multi-unit lookup. Factors read rendehr_concepts_unit_conversion_map.csv, keyed concept_name source_unit. target unit always taken unit column concept config (map file). source unit listed map also match target unit set NULL, row without unit. map row empty factor records unit excluded purpose (example absolute count reported percentage concept); values NULL . Use source column contains one unit across rows (e.g. CRP mimic_iv stored mg/dL ug/mL). val_var Source column name holding raw value. unit_var Source column name holding unit label (may NA). target_unit Target unit string (unit column concept config); used reference conditional conversion. concept_name Concept name. Required conversion = "map" unit conversion map can filtered correct concept.

title: Build SQL for a concept's unit conversion — concept_unit_conversion_func
code: cat(concept_unit_conversion_func("f_to_c", "valuenum", "valueuom", "C", "temperature")) #> CASE #>          WHEN src.valueuom IS NULL THEN CASE #>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$' #>      THEN CASE #>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28 #>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9)) #>        ELSE NULL #>      END #>      ELSE NULL #>    END #>          WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(src.valueuom AS TEXT))) = LOWER(TRIM('C')) THEN CASE #>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$' #>      THEN CASE #>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28 #>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9)) #>        ELSE NULL #>      END #>      ELSE NULL #>    END #>          WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(src.valueuom AS TEXT))) IN ('f', '°f', '?f', 'deg. f', 'deg.f', 'deg f', 'degf', 'degrees f', 'fahrenheit') THEN (CASE #>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$' #>      THEN CASE #>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28 #>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9)) #>        ELSE NULL #>      END #>      ELSE NULL #>    END - 32) * 5.0/9.0 #>          ELSE NULL #>        END

title: Generate a guided rendehR setup script — ehr_setup_assistant
text: src_name Optional source name character vector source names. NULL, assistant asks first whether use demo full sources, lets user choose one sources. source_size Source size mode: "demo" "full". Demo recommended first tests small require PhysioNet credentials. engine Database backend generated script: "postgres" (default) runs complete pipeline, "duckdb" cohort selection raw loading (Postgres server needed part). Compatible concept layers support DuckDB separately; assistant generate . Harmonization, comorbidities, ISS, clinical/ SCI annotations, merge_sources() require PostgreSQL omitted generated script engine = "duckdb"; pipeline forced "stages" (run_one_source() still uses PostgreSQL loading downstream stages), run_comorbidities/run_iss/merge/inspect_options forced since require PostgreSQL. db_name Database name stored project config. DuckDB loading open PostgreSQL connection. base_dir Project root directory place generated code. Holds config, SQL, generated files. data_dir Directory large data: raw PhysioNet downloads cohort parquet outputs. NULL, assistant asks interactively defaults file.path(base_dir, "data"). Raw downloads go physionet_data subfolder cohort parquet cohorts_data subfolder. Point large disk keep heavy files project directory. config_setup Project config handling mode: "manual" creates missing templates user edit, "interactive" creates missing config assistant answers, "skip" requires existing config. Existing files preserved; generated code stops conflicting settings. old value "template" accepted alias "manual". include_disk_check Include read-disk-space check snippet generated script? Mainly useful full-data runs. cohort Cohort mode: "scid", "sepsis3", "custom", "none". icd_filter_path Path custom ICD filter file cohort = "custom". pipeline Pipeline style: "stages" emits stage--stage calls; "full" emits run_one_source() possible. include_download Include download_source() block script? raw_data_dir Optional parent raw-data storage root (source directories live underneath ). Used consistently downloads, config import. run_comorbidities Include Charlson/Elixhauser comorbidity stage generated build script? Defaults TRUE SCI, FALSE otherwise. run_iss Include Injury Severity Score (ISS/NISS) stage generated build script? Defaults TRUE SCI, FALSE otherwise. analysis_level Desired unit analysis: "admission" hospital admission/native-grain analysis, "icu" ICU-stay analysis. matches analysis_level values used across package (e.g. merge_sources(), get_patient_ts()). "hadm" accepted deprecated alias "admission". make_icu_timeline Deprecated/compatibility shortcut. supplied analysis_level NULL, TRUE maps analysis_level = "icu" FALSE maps analysis_level = "admission". window_before_hours Hours ICU admission include ICU projection block. window_after_hours Hours ICU discharge include ICU projection block. include_other_icu_events Include ICU-native events ICU stays fall inside requested ICU window? include_date_only_events Include date-events ICU projection? materialize_icu TRUE, generate table ts_icu; FALSE, generate view. merge Merge mode: "none", "admission", "icu". target_schema Target schema optional merge block. inspect_options Character vector post-build inspect/analyze snippets include. Choices "tables", "cohort", "concepts", "patient_timeline", "descriptive", "none". load_method generated script load rendehR: "library", "load_all", "none". package_path Package path used load_method = "load_all". save_script Save generated script disk? NULL interactive, assistant asks end. non-interactive, NULL treated FALSE. setup_script_path Path generated script saved. Defaults file.path(base_dir, "ehr_setup_script.R") saving. overwrite_setup_script Overwrite existing saved script? Default FALSE. interactive TRUE, print guide prompt missing values. FALSE, use defaults return generated plan silently. import_scope Surrounding data retain: "patient", "hospital", "icu". Choices finer selected source's cohort key. Defaults hospital Sepsis-3, patient otherwise. Unfiltered mode accepts patient. Context encounters automatically become members. sepsis_bundle Sepsis-3 variant: "sepsis3", "first_sepsis3", "sepsis3_admission", "first_sepsis3_admission". sepsis3. memory_limit Optional DuckDB memory size, e.g. "4GB", sepsis selection/import. threads Optional positive integer worker count sepsis selection/import.

title: Generate a guided rendehR setup script — ehr_setup_assistant
code: project <- file.path(tempdir(), "rendehr-project") plan <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, interactive = FALSE) cat(plan$script) #> # Generated by ehr_setup_assistant(). #> # Review this script and run it block by block in your own R session. #> # The assistant printed this code; it did not run downloads or write to the database. #>  #> # Step 0 - Load rendehR -------------------------------------------------- #> # Use library(rendehR) after installation, or devtools::load_all() while developing locally. #> library(rendehR) #>  #> # Step 1 - Set parameters ------------------------------------------------ #> # src_names can contain one source or several sources. #> # Every pipeline call below passes src_name explicitly. #> # base_dir is the project root (config, SQL, generated files); created here if missing. #> # data_dir is for the large files (raw downloads, cohort parquet, DuckDB); point it at a large disk. #> # raw_data_root, cohort_parquet_root, and duckdb_root are stored in the config so every stage uses them. #> src_names <- c("mimic_iv_demo") #> default_src <- src_names[[1]] #> db_name <- "rendehr" #> base_dir <- "/tmp/Rtmpew7WRg/rendehr-project" #> data_dir <- "/tmp/Rtmpew7WRg/rendehr-project/data" #> raw_data_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'physionet_data') #> cohort_parquet_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'cohorts_data') #> duckdb_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'duckdb') #> import_scope <- "patient" #> # Patient: retain all available encounters for selected patients; uses more storage. #> # Imported context does not automatically become cohort membership. #> if (!dir.exists(base_dir)) dir.create(base_dir, recursive = TRUE) #> if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE) #>  #> # Step 1b - Project config ------------------------------------------------ #> # Only missing config/credentials files are created; existing files are never overwritten. #> # Config setup mode: manual. #> project_config_path <- file.path(base_dir, 'config', 'ehr_config.json') #> credentials_config_path <- file.path(base_dir, 'config', 'config_pass.json') #> if (!file.exists(project_config_path)) { #>   ehr_create_config_template( #>     path = project_config_path, #>     src_name = default_src, #>     db_name = db_name, #>     base_dir = base_dir, #>     raw_data_root = raw_data_root, #>     cohort_parquet_root = cohort_parquet_root, #>     duckdb_root = duckdb_root, #>     credentials_path = "config/config_pass.json", #>     cohort_profile = "scid", #>     overwrite = FALSE #>   ) #> } #> if (!file.exists(credentials_config_path)) ehr_create_credentials_template(credentials_config_path) #> # Existing configuration and credentials are preserved. #> # Edit the configuration and credentials before continuing with the next block. #> cfg <- ehr_load_config(project_config_path) #> # Stop before downloads or database stages when saved settings conflict with this plan. #> same_path <- function(a, b) identical(normalizePath(path.expand(a), winslash = '/', mustWork = FALSE), normalizePath(path.expand(b), winslash = '/', mustWork = FALSE)) #> resolve_config_path <- function(p) { if (is.null(p)) return(NULL); if (grepl('^/|^[A-Za-z]:', p) || startsWith(p, '~')) path.expand(p) else file.path(cfg$project$base_dir, p) } #> if (!identical(cfg$cohort$profile, "scid")) stop('Config cohort profile conflicts with this plan; review the config or regenerate the plan.') #> if (!identical(cfg$database$db_name, db_name)) stop('Config database conflicts with this plan.') #> if (!identical(cfg$source$src_name, default_src)) stop('Config default source conflicts with this plan.') #> if (!same_path(cfg$project$base_dir, base_dir)) stop('Config project directory conflicts with this plan.') #> expected_roots <- list(raw_data_root = raw_data_root, cohort_parquet_root = cohort_parquet_root, duckdb_root = duckdb_root) #> for (root in names(expected_roots)) { #>   actual <- resolve_config_path(cfg$paths[[root]]) #>   if (is.null(actual) || !same_path(actual, expected_roots[[root]])) stop('Config storage path conflicts with this plan: ', root) #> } #> ehr_use_config(project_config_path) #> for (src in src_names) { #>   check <- ehr_check_config(src_name = src, quiet = FALSE) #>   if (!isTRUE(check$ok)) stop(paste(check$problems, collapse = '; ')) #> } #>  #> # Step 2 - Download source data ------------------------------------------ #> # Skipped in this generated script. Run download_source(src_name) later if data are not present. #>  #> # Step 3 - Build selected source(s) -------------------------------------- #> # Stage-by-stage is recommended for a first run because each output can be inspected. #> # Only one source was selected, so the generated code runs directly without a loop. #> src <- default_src #> # 3a. Import/subset source files to cohort parquet. #> # overwrite = FALSE reuses compatible cohort artifacts or reports a conflict; #> # set TRUE to force a rebuild. #> import_cohort_general( #>   src_name = src, #>   base_dir = base_dir, #>   raw_data_root = raw_data_root, #>   import_scope = import_scope, #>   overwrite = FALSE #> ) #>  #> # 3b. Load cohort parquet to Postgres raw schema. #> run_db( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3c. Apply source-specific raw table modifications (eICU views/renames; no-op for MIMIC). #> run_raw_mods( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3d. admission_windows/icu_windows/visit_windows were already loaded by #> # run_db() above (with cohort_index from the cohort parquet). Do not call #> # build_window_tables() here - it would rebuild them from raw admissions/ #> # icustays with no cohort filtering, overwriting the cohort-aware tables. #>  #> # 3e. Build cohort_info from cohort_index; SCI enrichment follows the profile. #> build_cohort_info_general( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3f. Compute Charlson and Elixhauser comorbidity indices. #> # Requires the comorbidity package; set run_comorbidities = FALSE in ehr_setup_assistant() to omit. #> run_comorbidities( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3g. Compute Injury Severity Score (ISS/NISS). #> # Requires icdpicr/icdpicr2; set run_iss = FALSE in ehr_setup_assistant() to omit. #> run_iss( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3h. Build source-specific concept tables. #> run_concepts( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # 3i. Combine concepts into harmonized ts_tab, flat_tab, and dur_tab. #> run_harmonized_tables( #>   src_name = src, #>   db_name = db_name, #>   base_dir = base_dir #> ) #>  #> # Step 6 - Connect for inspection ---------------------------------------- #> # Post-build inspection helpers open database queries using stored credentials. #> # Run this after editing config/config_pass.json and after the database has been created. #> ehr_connect( #>   db_name = db_name #> ) #>  #> # Step 7 - Inspect and analyze outputs ----------------------------------- #> # These examples use default_src, the first selected source. #> # They are meant as starting points for exploration after the build finishes. #>  #> # 7a. Show database sources and tables by schema. #> list_sources() #> tables_by_schema <- lapply(c('raw', 'concepts', 'derived', 'harmonized'), function(schema) { #>   local({ tables <- list_tables(default_src, schema = schema); data.frame(schema = rep(schema, length(tables)), table = tables) }) #> }) #> names(tables_by_schema) <- c('raw', 'concepts', 'derived', 'harmonized') #> tables_by_schema #>  #> # 7b. Summarize the cohort and inspect admission/ICU windows. #> cohort_summary(default_src) #> load_admission_windows(default_src, n = 10) #> load_icu_windows(default_src, n = 10) #>  #> # 7c. List/search concepts and summarize one available concept. #> concepts <- list_concepts(default_src) #> head(concepts, 20) #> search_concepts('lactate', src_name = default_src) #> concept_to_check <- if (nrow(concepts) > 0) concepts$concept_name[[1]] else NA_character_ #> if (!is.na(concept_to_check)) concept_summary(default_src, concept_to_check) #>  #> # 7d. Inspect one patient timeline. Replace the placeholder first. #> patient_id <- 'REPLACE_WITH_PATIENT_ID' #> if (!identical(patient_id, 'REPLACE_WITH_PATIENT_ID')) { #>   patient_ts <- get_patient_ts(default_src, patient_id, analysis_level = 'admission') #>   head(patient_ts) #>   if (requireNamespace('ggplot2', quietly = TRUE) && nrow(patient_ts) > 0) { #>     ggplot2::ggplot(patient_ts, ggplot2::aes(time_since_hadm_min, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)), color = concept_name)) + #>       ggplot2::geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) + #>       ggplot2::labs(x = 'Minutes since hospital admission', y = 'Value', color = 'Concept') + #>       ggplot2::theme(legend.position = 'none') #>   } #> } else { #>   message('Set patient_id to a real source patient identifier before running the timeline example.') #> } #>  #> # 7e. Simple descriptive summaries from flat_tab and ts_tab. #> flat <- fetch_table(default_src, 'flat_tab', schema = 'harmonized', n = Inf) #> if ('sex' %in% names(flat)) table(flat$sex, useNA = 'ifany') #> if ('race' %in% names(flat)) sort(table(flat$race, useNA = 'ifany'), decreasing = TRUE) #> age_col <- intersect(c('age', 'age_hos_admit', 'age_icu_intime'), names(flat))[1] #> if (!is.na(age_col)) summary(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(flat[[age_col]]))) #> mort_col <- intersect(c('hospital_mortality', 'death_in_hospital', 'icu_mortality', 'mortality'), names(flat))[1] #> if (!is.na(mort_col)) table(flat[[mort_col]], useNA = 'ifany') #> ts_sample <- fetch_table(default_src, 'ts_tab', schema = 'harmonized', n = 100000) #> if ('concept_name' %in% names(ts_sample)) sort(table(ts_sample$concept_name), decreasing = TRUE) #> if (all(c('concept_name', 'value') %in% names(ts_sample))) { #>   ts_sample$value_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ts_sample$value)) #>   aggregate(value_num ~ concept_name, data = ts_sample, FUN = function(x) c(n = sum(!is.na(x)), median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE))) #> } sepsis <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, cohort = "sepsis3",   import_scope = "hospital", sepsis_bundle = "first_sepsis3_admission",   interactive = FALSE) sci <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, cohort = "scid",   import_scope = "hospital", interactive = FALSE)

title: Pivot the harmonized time series into wide format (one column per concept) — fetch_concepts_wide
text: src_name Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo"). spec Named list mapping concept character vector aggregates. Supported: "min", "max", "mean", "median", "sd", "variance", "sum", "n"/"count", "first", "last"; "all_numeric" expands numeric reducers. unnamed character vector defaults concept "mean"; named character vector interpreted concept = aggregate shorthand. Example: list(hr = c("mean", "max"), sbp = "mean", gcs = "last", urine = "sum"). bin_min Bin width minutes (default 60). NULL disables binning pivots raw timestamp. emitted t_bin column 0-based bin index (floor(time / bin_min)), e.g. 0, 1, 2, ... hourly bins. analysis_level "admission" (default) pivots ts_tab time_since_hadm_min; "icu" pivots ts_icu time_since_icu_min, keyed assigned_icustay_id ICU stay separate observation ICU clock. window Optional c(from_bin, to_bin) bin-index units, inclusive ends, restricting output bins (applied SQL aggregation). E.g. bin_min = 60, c(0, 47) keeps first 48 h, c(0, 0) keeps first hour. NULL (default) keeps bins. complete_grid TRUE, emit row every bin window (, window NULL, observed bin range) stay present long table, left-joining aggregates onto full grid unmeasured bins come back NA (imputation - fill/mask downstream). Regularizes shape , length--stay eligibility. Requires non-NULL bin_min. Default FALSE. n Max rows return. Default Inf. cohort_only TRUE (default), pivot rows cohort members (cohort_index source's cohort_info), matched requested analysis_level: admission id "admission", assigned ICU stay "icu" (needs cohort_info built analysis_level = "icu"). Applied SQL aggregation. FALSE reads imported context rows; recover data never imported. clean "none" (default) pivots values stored. "range" excludes readings outside concept's physiologic [min, max] (ends inclusive) SQL, aggregation, using bounds clean_by_range(): concept config's widest window across sources, matched exact concept name. Every aggregate computed valid readings (first/last/n first/last/number valid readings), concept gets <concept>_n_cleaned column counting readings excluded bin (0 concepts bound, left unchanged message), result carries clean_report attribute per concept: n, n_cleaned, n_not_numeric (missing non-numeric values), min_value, max_value. bin whose readings excluded NA; _n_cleaned > 0 tells apart bin measurement. complete_grid, unmeasured grid bins NA . ranges Optional bounds overriding config, formats accepted clean_by_range(): named list c(min, max) data frame concept_name, min_value, max_value. Requires clean = "range". con Optional explicit DBI connection. case_adm_only, scope_only Removed; supplying either error. Use cohort_only.

title: Materialize the current cohort as canonical Parquet — import_cohort_general
text: src_name Registered source name. base_dir Project root. raw_data_root Optional parent source-specific raw directory. icd_filter_path ICD-code CSV RDS file icd_code column icd_version column (9 10). icd_version required MIMIC-IV eICU; MIMIC-III may omitted (ICD-9 assumed) ICD-10 rows excluded. code matches stated version. direct_ids_path CSV, CSV.GZ, Parquet, RDS identifier file. cohort Bundled named cohort. cohort_sql Final selection query; use setup_sql dependencies. setup_sql Optional ordered SQL statements files. cohort_fn Function function name returning identifiers. no_filter Select whole available source. key Explicit configured hierarchy key. import_scope Patient, hospital, ICU, configured hierarchy key. allow_unmatched_ids Permit partially unmatched selection least one identifier matches. window_sql, window_fn Optional hierarchy builder override. tables Optional bounded table subset. memory_limit, threads, temp_directory Optional DuckDB resource limits. table_chunk_rows Row threshold (table's configured num_rows, extra scan needed). Tables built multiple smaller INSERT batches (split hash cohort link-key column) instead one single CREATE TABLE SELECT, peak memory stays bounded even DuckDB's --core spilling enough single huge table (e.g. MIMIC-III chartevents). Default 5e6 chunks tables large enough need ; small tables unaffected either way. Pass NULL always build every table one shot. Reference (unfiltered) tables never chunked. validate_columns TRUE, scan every configured column every built table count values fail convert (TRY_CAST) configured type, stopping build required patient/visit linkage column failures missing raw data. default (FALSE) scan touches full raw data every table (including huge ones like chartevents) expensive; skipping trusts source's linkage columns already well-formed (reasonable default vetted source like published MIMIC data, less new, unvetted institutional extract). Reference tables never checked either way. ignore_errors TRUE (default), raw CSV row fails parse (beyond null_padding/lenient parsing already tolerates) skipped rather aborting whole table's read - avoids losing entire large import one bad row. Combined store_rejects, row still recorded, silently dropped. Set FALSE fail hard malformed row instead. store_rejects TRUE (default), skipped rows (ignore_errors = TRUE) recorded - file/line, column, - returned csv_reject_report instead vanishing trace. effect nothing gets skipped. use_parquet_cache TRUE (default), table whose raw CSV already cached parquet cache_raw_parquet_duckdb() read parquet instead re-parsing CSV. Tables without cached parquet still fall back CSV. Set FALSE always read CSV. overwrite Safely replace one current completed Parquet cohort? show_progress Print aggregate progress. cohort_selection Optional overrides cohort_selection_options() named list. windows Optional overrides window_options() named list. loading Optional overrides loading_options() named list. execution Optional overrides execution_options() named list.

title: SCI-specific classify_fn for use with run_cohort_info() — scid_classify
text: diag_exp Expanded diagnostic data frame built generic builder. con DBI connection. raw_schema Raw Postgres schema name. src_name Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo"). group_col Visit grouping column (e.g. "hadm_id", "patienthealthsystemstayid"). icds_scid_path Path canonical SCI ICD classification (RDS CSV). Defaults package-embedded scid_icds_rendehr.rds. icds_cause_path Path injury cause/etiology CSV. Defaults package-embedded file. icds_proc_path Path SCI procedure classification CSV. Optional. supplied, MIMIC sources also gain procedure columns d_scid_operation_procedures_icds_rendehr reference table. eICU ICD-coded procedure table, reports proc_classification_status = "not_reported" typed-NA procedure columns regardless. icds_proc_dict_path Path ICD procedure description CSV. Optional. publish Whether publish procedure dictionary raw_schema. Set FALSE caller defers publication clinical tables, compute-call write database.

title: SCI-specific classify_fn for use with run_cohort_info() — scid_classify
text: Data frame keyed group_col SCI enrichment columns. SCI categories use dictionary's is_sci (1 spinal cord, 3 cord symptoms, 999 possible cord, 2 nerve root, 0 spinal control) is_tr (1 traumatic, 0 non-traumatic, 2 unspecified): top_level: "Spinal cord damage" code is_sci 1, 3 999; else "Nerve roots injury disease" 2; else "Spinal control". second_level: SCI stays, decided SCI codes - "Traumatic SCI" traumatic, else "Non-traumatic SCI" non-traumatic, else "Unspecified SCI". Nerve-root stays "Nerve root injury disease". Control stays "Spinal trauma control" code traumatic, else "Spinal non-trauma control". scid_trauma_types: trauma statuses SCI codes, joined | (e.g. "non_traumatic|traumatic"); NA non-SCI stays. scid_nontrauma_l1, scid_nontrauma_l2: etiology SCI codes non-traumatic SCI, joined " | "; "not_applicable" otherwise.

title: rendehR 1.0.0
text: bundled ICD diagnosis dictionary (d_icd_diagnoses.csv) rebuilt public CMS ICD-9-CM (v23-v32) ICD-10-CM (FY2016-FY2025) files data-raw/d_icd_diagnoses.R. covers every code previous dictionary except three ICD-9 category headers (780.0, V12.7, V58.1). Eleven retired ICD-9 codes eICU diagnoses unmatched now resolve ICD-9. SCI stays classified SCI codes . stay cord, cord-symptom possible-cord code (is_sci 1, 3 999) SCI, second level traumatic, non-traumatic unspecified depending codes. now six second-level categories instead eight; new scid_trauma_types column lists trauma status SCI codes. eICU medication tables keep raw columns add parsed mod_* columns (drug name, dose rate, unit, start stop) medication_mod, infusiondrug_mod admissiondrug_mod. Orders blank drug name (36 % eICU 2.0) get name drug code rendehr_eicu_hicl_drugname_lookup.csv, file name project config directory replaces. Infusion doses now charted rate, amount bag. eICU exposure patterns match better: hydromorphone also matches misspelling “Hydromorphine”, acetaminophen hydrocodone longer match chlorpheniramine, lepirudin matches recombinant form, linaclotide longer counted sodium chloride. eICU ionized calcium labelled mg/dL throughout, hospitals report mmol/L label. new conversion ca_ionized_by_value reads unit value (2 mmol/L, 3.5 mg/dL, gap left empty); quarter eICU values mmol/L wrongly divided 4. Calcium bounds follow ricu: 4-20 mg/dL total 0.5-2 mmol/L ionized calcium (0-10000). Bounds affect opt-range cleaning. eICU FiO2 also reads “FIO2 (%)” label; FiO2 lower bound 20 %. pH, INR, GCS RASS carry unit (pH, ratio, score) instead text 'NA'. Hospital discharges hospice hospice hospital_discharge_location (death; nearly patients left hospital alive). Concepts without unit (medication exposures, flags) store missing unit instead text 'NA'. concept registry credits concept’s origin: concepts defined rendehR name package, BlendedICU medication concepts cite paper, eICU derived concepts link MIT-LCP eICU-CRD code. time-series configuration longer names PhysioNet origin. ICD code columns clinical lookups (SCI list, injury causes, procedure classification, dictionaries) user’s ICD list read text, codes leading zeros 0331 keep . validate_concept_config() checks concept configuration lists invalid row. concept stage runs first warns every problem. Rows empty match_value unknown itm_class skipped named warning, missing user_concepts file stops stage.

title: rendehR 1.0.0
text: rendehR now licensed GNU General Public License, version 3 (GPL-3), license ricu, whose concept definitions part concept layer modelled. MIT-licensed material uses (MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code eICU-Code SQL, BlendedICU medication list OMOP ingredient IDs) keeps copyright notices inst/COPYRIGHTS. documentation now set tested articles: get started, projects configuration, cohorts, pipeline, harmonized data, concepts, explorer, Sepsis-3 cohorts, setup assistant, adding source, MCP server. Every example run open demo data; vignettes precomputed, building package renders stored outputs without database network. MCP bundle version 1.0.0, package version, three skills (rendehr-user, rendehr-add-concept, rendehr-add-source) nine read-tools. Tool arguments must JSON object, numbers keep full precision, list_loaded_concepts reports total, cohort_summary errors source cohort tables. bundled example cohorts scid (spinal cord injury, ICD list) sepsis3 (Sepsis-3 SQL); traumatic brain injury list (tbi) removed. retired cohort entry points (import_cohort(), import_cohort_flex(), run_cohort_duckdb(), select_cohort_ids_duckdb()) aliases: use import_cohort_general(), materialize_cohort_duckdb() select_cohort_ids(). drop_database() gains confirm argument, apps can pass name user typed; non-interactive sessions longer wait console prompt. New projects default "generic" cohort profile. Set cohort.profile = "scid" SCI reference implementation, also turns clinical enrichment defaults. bundled SCI ICD dictionary v2.2.3 dictionary (scid_icds_rendehr.rds, default; CSV table). keeps codes SCI/trauma flags, describes location anatomical_region specific_level snake_case. cohort_info, scid_injury_level now holds region ("cervical", "thoracic", …), scid_injury_location coded level ("c5", "t11_t12", …), non-traumatic placeholder "not_applicable". cohort_summary() counts people rather admission rows; SCI enrichment runs diagnosis-selected SCI cohorts; user SQL subfolders concepts_sqls/user executed; ICU-level setup scripts build cohort table ICU grain; run_concepts() stops source’s raw modifications missing; relative base_dir resolves absolute path ; cohort selection plan prints counts without identifiers. cohort explorer (run_explorer()) simpler design rebuilt Setup page configures project several sources runs pipeline stages , concept builder drafts, previews saves new edited time-series concepts user_concepts file. Small-cell masking now also suppresses cells percentages masked count recovered, Kaplan-Meier curves use one index admission per patient.
